clips.title: The story
paras: In the Charred Vale, Smoldering Embers remain after fire elementals are extinguished. Night elf Sentinels gather them as proof that the fires are being subdued.

Venture Company logging and industry set the Charred Vale ablaze and stirred destructive forces from deep within the earth. Burning Ravagers, Burning Destroyers, and Rogue Flame Spirits then swept across the scorched basin. When an elemental is extinguished, its ash-covered core remains as a Smoldering Ember. These cinders show that the fires overrunning the vale are being brought under control.
